releaseNotes: v5.1.13 — Account delete fixed + Trades tab rebuilt + offline voice + import everything + animated BUBU: deleting an account never moves its trades into another account — choose delete-with-trades or move to Backup; Delete All, Fresh start and selective delete added. Trades tab rebuilt: readable rows, green/red P&L, PLAYED/FAILED badges, level chips, BUY/SELL badges, tappable filters, sort, click a row to expand it, Incomplete filter to finish imported trades later. Voice now works OFFLINE with on-device Whisper (model downloads once, then no internet needed); English-to-Urdu translation still needs internet and says so. Import Data now takes Screenshot, PDF, Excel and CSV in BOTH the Screenshot Reader tab and MT5 Import — every row is validated, green = read cleanly, amber = check this value, rows that do not read cleanly are listed and never guessed. BUBU is now Sir's own picture, animated: calm when idle, typing while he works, with a status line naming the job. Quick Add small cards first, big cards last; Fill from screenshot is a real button; Theme quick-pick removed. Everything from v5.1.12 unchanged, including the updater.
